description: Pinned real manufacturer datasheets for COMPONENT-SYNTHESIS-1 source verification. The PDFs are copyrighted manufacturer documents and are deliberately NOT redistributed in this repository: only their digests, acquisition origin, and independently transcribed expected values are stored here. scripts/acquire_corpus.py downloads the exact pinned bytes into build/corpus/, which is gitignored. Corpus-backed tests SKIP when the bytes are absent; a skip is never a pass.
